lastResponse.text: Next step: I can connect you to a live specialist now and I’ll speak slowly. If your brother is in crisis right now, call Crisis Text Line at 4-4-3, 7-8-7, 6-7-7-8. I’ll repeat: 4-4-3, 7-8-7, 6-7-7-8.
